elements.name: Verify that sorting, filtering and exporting behave the same way on the "Suspended" sub-tab

steps.name: I am logged in as an "Admin" user
I am on the "Users" tab
the users list state is reset
I click on the "Suspended" sub-tab
the "Suspended" sub-tab should be highlighted as active
the table should either list users or show the empty state
the Export CSV control should be visible and enabled
I export the users list as CSV
the downloaded file should be named "NXTSTIM.csv"
the export should mirror this sub-tab exactly
I sort the users by "ID: Asc"
the selected Sort By option should be "ID: Asc"
the full list of user IDs should be in "ascending" order, or the sub-tab should be empty
I note the full list of user IDs
I sort the users by "ID: Desc"
the selected Sort By option should be "ID: Desc"
the full list of user IDs should be in "descending" order, or the sub-tab should be empty
the full list of user IDs should be the reverse of the noted order, or the sub-tab should be empty
I filter by a Role offered on this sub-tab
the filtered result should be exactly the users on this sub-tab that carry that Role
no application error should be shown
